answer: Audits are entered in whisper, queued in ember, and bridge publishes the wait time. A farm of 119 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 83 identities per epoch. A farm of 1613 identities would post 1536 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
